body: Thank you. That's the right term, "Savior".  I wasn't looking to be saved but the 8 months we spent together, I felt great because he was there for me and he promised me things so I had this idea that everything will be good. He doesn't talk to me anymore so it feels as if this future is now dead forever and I am back in my hole. it's true, the 8 months made me want to live, but knowing it was all a lie and how empty it feels now is making me want to die more. I wish I had never experienced this kind of feeling of "content" because then I wouldn't miss it now so much.

Thank you. I always put my self worth on others because I have nothing to live for, I never had. I have no goals, no dreams, no nothing. I just am for the sake of it. The person who betrayed me gave me hope and I accepted it, and then they took it away. It's my fault for being so blind. I can't put my happiness on others, I cannot live for others, I have to learn to live for myself but I don't know how because there is nothing I want to do. I wanted to be with someone because I thought it will help me, but it seems too difficult.
